content:
michael: Heads-up: saw repeated scale-down/scale-up of the eu-west gpu pool this morning. After a large batch job finished nodes drained, metrics-server briefly dropped to 0 metrics and cluster-autoscaler then scaled the tainted GPU nodes down. Caused a cascade when jobs requeued.

anya: Oof. Was that after the metrics-server bump last night? We upgraded to 0.6.5 around 02:00.

sara: yes — I correlated kubelet logs and metrics-server errors: "failed to get summary from Kubelet" during the eviction window. metrics-server goes quiet for ~30s which CA interprets as idle.

michael: Quick mitigation idea: ensure metrics-server has tolerations/nodeSelector so it runs on control-plane or non-preemptible nodes in each AZ, and increase metric resolution to avoid short blips. Also consider CA flags to ignore transient zero metrics.

tom: Also check CA helm values — we currently pass some args via values.yaml. CA defaults don't account for tainted GPU-only nodepools. There's `--skip-nodes-with-local-storage` etc. We might need `--nodes=0:20:gpu-pool` explicit sizing and `--balance-similar-node-groups=false` to stop thrash.

anya: From automation POV: plan is to patch the terraform module for gpu nodepools to set `node_taints = [\"gpu=true:NoSchedule\"]` (already set) and add a small change to the CA helm release values via terraform `helm_release` resource: add `extraArgs` plus increase `metricResolution` for metrics-server. We'll codify the metrics-server tolerations in infra-helm overlay so it deploys with a non-spot placement.

sara: If we're changing metrics-server via helm, do it as a small overlay in our infra repo so terraform applies it. Example values we'll try:
```yaml
metricsServer:
  tolerations:
  - key: "node-role.kubernetes.io/control-plane"
    operator: "Exists"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
  args:
  - --metric-resolution=60s
```
This should reduce transient zeros.

michael: +1. Also add a canary rollout for the helm release (`maxUnavailable: 1`) and monitor CA events for 30m before promoting to prod.

devops-bot: deploy started for metrics-server-staging (helm release metrics-server-staging) by anya at 2026-03-18T09:12:45Z :rocket:

tom: cost note: if we simply increase min nodes to avoid flapping the pool, that raises monthly spend ~8% for that GPU pool. Prefer fixes that keep min=0 and avoid permanent capacity reservations.

anya: Agreed. First try tolerations + longer metric interval + CA args patch. If still unstable during peak windows we can set a temporary min=1 and schedule pre-warming.

sara: I'll open a PR against terraform-modules/gpu-nodepool to (1) ensure taint + node labels are consistent, (2) add a helm values patch for cluster-autoscaler extraArgs, and (3) add metrics-server overlay values. Will include notes about the liveness interaction in the README.

michael: Please also add a smoke job in CI that runs for 5m and exports a small steady metric so metrics-server has no cold-start gap. That should catch regressions.

sara: noted. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-modules/pull/472 :eyes:

michael: Cool — ping here when staging is green and CA events look stable.
